item.title: Senator urges DOTD to address safety issues on I-12 near Albany after weekend ends in 4 deaths
item.description: ALBANY &mdash; State Senator Valarie Hodges is urging the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development to address possible safety concerns along I-12 near Albany after four people were killed in two separate crashes within days of each other.The first crash happened Feb. 13, when a vehicle crossed the median and struck two trucks. item.title: Bayou Vista Fire Department works Friday night house fire on Carolyn Road
item.description: BAYOU VISTA - The Bayou Vista Volunteer Fire Department worked a house fire Friday night on Carolyn Road, officials said.The call was received at 10:53 p.m.; officials said they saw light smoke coming from the house when they arrived and the fire resulted in heavy fire damage to the kitchen.Fire officials said the homeowner had been cooking and stepped into the living room when the fire began. No one was injured as a result of the fire.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Livingston Parish deputies locate parents of found child
item.description: LIVINGSTON &mdash; Deputies with the Livingston Parish Sheriff's Office found a missing child on Saturday.According to Livingston Parish Sheriff Jason Ard, the child was found on Suma Hill Road.&nbsp;Deputies said the Louisiana Department of Children and Family Services originally took the child into custody.&nbsp;Sheriff Ard later confirmed that the parents of the child were located and the child was identified.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Save Our Sons hosts 23rd annual Black History Parade in Port Allen
item.description: PORT ALLEN &mdash; Residents in Port Allen celebrated Black History Month with the 23rd annual Black History Parade on Saturday.&nbsp;The parade, hosted by Save Our Sons, began at William and Lee Park before rolling through the rest of Port Allen.Parade goers enjoyed live music, food and drinks after the parade rolled by.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Franklin under a boil water advisory after the failure of a raw water intake pump
item.description: FRANKLIN &mdash; The city of Franklin is under a boil water advisory after a raw water intake pump failed on Friday.A temporary replacement pump later failed to prime, causing the water plant to shut down to prevent further damage until a new pump could be installed. item.title: Report: NFL receiver Rondale Moore dead at 25
item.description: NEW ALBANY, Ind. - Minnesota Vikings receiver Rondale Moore was found dead in a garage Saturday in southwest Indiana, according to WHAS11. He was 25.The Floyd County Coroner's Office confirmed his death to WHAS11 Saturday night. Officials said Moore was found in a garage with a suspected self-inflicted gunshot wound.His autopsy is scheduled for Sunday.Moore, who played for Purdue in college, was drafted in the second round by the Arizona Cardinals in 2021.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Friends of the Seniors Gala held in New Roads
item.description: NEW ROADS - The annual "Friends of the Seniors Gala" kicked off in New Roads on Saturday.It started around 5 p.m. at the Circa Event Center. Guests enjoyed an auction, food and refreshments.Lieutenant Russel Honore is tonight's key note speaker. The proceeds for the event will go toward supporting the community.Permalink| Comments
